style.nav-bar: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; width: 100%; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 22px 120px; background-color: var(--hl-cream); border-bottom: 1px solid #eadacb; @media(--tablet) { padding: 18px 40px; } @media(--mobile) { padding: 14px 16px; }
style.nav-inner: width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0;
style.nav-logo: flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0; text-decoration: none; flex-shrink: 0;
style.nav-logo-mark: width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--hl-coral); border: 3px solid var(--hl-cream); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--hl-coral); align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; flex-shrink: 0; @media(--mobile) { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
style.nav-logo-amp: font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; color: var(--hl-cream); @media(--mobile) { font-size: 21px; }
style.nav-logo-text: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0px; padding: 0;
style.nav-logo-name: font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: var(--hl-ink); @media(--mobile) { font-size: 24px; }
style.nav-logo-tag: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: var(--hl-ink); @media(--mobile) { font-size: 7px; }
style.nav-menu: flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 36px; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { gap: 18px; } @media(--mobile) { display: none; }
style.nav-cta: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); background-color: var(--hl-amber); border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 100px; padding: 15px 28px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #0e2a25; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; &:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #0e2a25; } @media(--tablet) { font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 22px; } @media(--mobile) { font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 18px; }
